string.source: base/doc/narrations/stzstring-emptiness-narration.md (Rule 3; the same rule is asserted in base/test/string/612_dealing_in_emptiness_in_softanza.ring)
string.what_en: The empty string is never contained, not even in itself, so a match on nothing can never trigger an edit.
string.what_fr: La chaîne vide n'est jamais contenue, pas même en elle-même : une correspondance sur rien ne peut déclencher aucune modification.

string.what_en: Length counts characters, not bytes: the accented word héllo has five characters although it takes six bytes.
string.what_fr: La longueur compte des caractères, pas des octets : le mot accentué héllo a cinq caractères alors qu'il occupe six octets.

string.what_en: Three letters that look identical are told apart by their code points and their scripts: Latin, Greek and Cyrillic.
string.what_fr: Trois lettres d'apparence identique se distinguent par leurs points de code et leurs écritures : latine, grecque et cyrillique.

regex.code:
# a number, then a string
? Lx("[@N, @S]").Match([42, "hello"])
# one to three numbers, then a string
? Lx("[@N1-3, @S]").Match([1, 2, "end"])
# anything but a number
? Lx("[@!N]").Match(["string"])
? Lx("[@!N]").Match([42])
regex.what_en: A list is matched by its shape, the way a regex matches text: a number then a string, one to three numbers then a string, anything but a number.
regex.what_fr: Une liste se reconnaît à sa forme, comme une expression régulière reconnaît un texte : un nombre puis une chaîne, de un à trois nombres puis une chaîne, tout sauf un nombre.

regex.what_en: A conditional pattern is declared like an if/else, international or local phone format, and the maker writes the regex.

regex.what_fr: Un nombre se reconnaît à ce qu'il est : 17 correspond au motif des nombres premiers, 18 non.

collections.what_en: One function finds a value in a string or in a list; only the unit changes, characters or items.
collections.what_fr: Une même fonction trouve une valeur dans une chaîne ou dans une liste ; seule l'unité change, caractères ou éléments.

neural.code:
oP = StzOutputSchemaQ([
	[ :field = "person", :type = :string ],
	[ :field = "age",    :type = :number, :must = [ [ ">=", 0 ], [ "<=", 130 ] ] ]
])
aLie = oP.ParseOutput('{ "person":"Ada Lovelace", "age":9 }')
chk("a schema-valid LIE validates -- Ada Lovelace was not nine", aLie[:ok] = 1)
chk("...and the court has no complaint to make about it", len(aLie[:findings]) = 0)
neural.expected:
[OK] a schema-valid LIE validates -- Ada Lovelace was not nine
  [OK] ...and the court has no complaint to make about it
neural.what_en: A well-formed answer that is false still passes: the schema guarantees shape, never truth, and the guard shows this limit on purpose.
neural.what_fr: Une réponse bien formée mais fausse passe quand même : le schéma garantit la forme, jamais la vérité, et le test montre cette limite exprès.

neural.code:
Scenario("a model with NO recorded digest is refused")
	Given("a byte-identical copy in a folder with no SHA256SUMS")
	When("it is loaded")
	# before: loaded; being identical to a good model is not the point --
	# nobody SAID this file is that model
	Then("it is refused", StzEngineNeuralModelLoad($cUnknown), 0)
	StzEngineNeuralModelFree()
EndScenario()
neural.expected:
SCENARIO: a model with NO recorded digest is refused
  GIVEN a byte-identical copy in a folder with no SHA256SUMS
  WHEN  it is loaded
  THEN  it is refused  [PASS]
  -> 1 pass, 0 fail
neural.what_en: A byte-for-byte copy of a good model is still refused, because nobody recorded its fingerprint; trusting it must be an explicit act.
neural.what_fr: Une copie identique, octet pour octet, d'un bon modèle est tout de même refusée, faute d'empreinte enregistrée ; lui faire confiance doit être un acte explicite.

# a notation declared as data: three kinds, a closed vocabulary, and no self-links
oFsm = new stzNotation("fsm51")
oFsm.AddKind("state", "circle")
oFsm.AddKind("final", "doublecircle")
oFsm.AddKind("task", "diamond")
oFsm.Close()
oFsm.Forbid(:SelfLink, "a state cannot transition to itself in fsm51; " +
	"model a stay as a guard on departure instead")
StzRegisterNotation(oFsm)

oDm = new stzDiagram("m51")
oDm.SetNotation("fsm51")
oDm.AddNodeXTT("a", "A", [ :type = "state" ])
oDm.AddNodeXTT("b", "B", [ :type = "task" ])
oDm.AddEdge("a", "b")
oDm.ToCanvasXT([ :NodeWidth = 96, :NodeHeight = 36 ])

nDnLog = len(oDm.EditLog())
bDnGot = oDm.Edit(:Link, [ "a", "a" ])
chk("a link the domain forbids is refused at the command",
    bDnGot = 0 and len(oDm.EditLog()) = nDnLog)
bDnGot = oDm.Edit(:Link, [ "b", "a" ])
chk("...while a lawful link passes the same gate",
    bDnGot = 1 and len(oDm.EditLog()) = nDnLog + 1)
diagramming.expected:
ok   a link the domain forbids is refused at the command
   ok   ...while a lawful link passes the same gate

oGov = new stzGovernance("shop")
? "no coverage stated -> " + oGov.MayRegister("mystery", "", "reversible")
? "  " + oGov.Why()
? "no reversal declared -> " + oGov.MayRegister("mystery", "reorders stock", "")
? "  " + oGov.Why()
? "both stated -> " + oGov.MayRegister("mystery", "reorders stock", :Compensable)
governance.expected:
no coverage stated -> 0
  AGENTLOOP-R4: agent 'mystery' declares no coverage statement. Registration refuses it. Say what this agent covers, in one sentence, before the loop will run it. Law 18: nothing schedules what nobody has stated the reach of.
no reversal declared -> 0
  AGENTLOOP-R5: agent 'mystery' declares no reversibility class. Registration refuses it. Declare one of: reversible | compensable | irreversible. Law 18: an agent whose reversal nobody stated cannot be scheduled by something that cannot undo it.
both stated -> 1
governance.what_en: An agent that does not say what it covers, or how reversible its work is, cannot be registered, and each refusal names its rule.
governance.what_fr: Un agent qui ne dit pas ce qu'il couvre, ou à quel point son travail est réversible, ne peut pas s'inscrire, et chaque refus nomme sa règle.

oG2 = new stzGovernance("billing")
oG2.DeclareRisk("send-invoice", 3)
oG2.GrantPermission("billing-agent", "send-invoice")
oG2.SetAuthority("billing-agent", :Delegated)
? "may it proceed? " + oG2.MayProceed("billing-agent", "send-invoice")
? "  " + oG2.Why()

platforms.code:
# two worlds: a restaurant and its produce supplier
oResto = StzAppQ("resto")
oResto.AddThingQ(:dish) { Has([ :name, :price ]) }
oSupplier = StzAppQ("supplier")
oSupplier.AddThingQ(:crate) { Has([ :produce, :qty ]) }

# one platform made of both: a shared ground, a bond, a rule
oCon = new stzSuperApp("acme-group")
oCon.AddWorld("resto", oResto)
oCon.AddWorld("supplier", oSupplier)
oCon.OpenCommonsOn(new stzDatabase(":memory:"))
oCon.StorePut("currency", "EUR")
oCon.Bond("resto", "supplier", "order-produce")
oCon.GovDeclareRisk("order-produce", 2)
oCon.GovGrant("resto", "order-produce")
oCon.GovSetAuthority("resto", :Delegated)

? oCon.StoreGet("currency")
? oCon.CallAcross("resto", "supplier", "order-produce")
? oCon.CallAcross("resto", "supplier", "raid-kitchen")
? oCon.Why()
platforms.what_en: Two worlds become one platform: they share a ground, the restaurant may order from its supplier because a bond declares it and governance clears it, and an action nobody declared is refused with its reason.
platforms.what_fr: Deux mondes deviennent une seule plateforme : ils partagent un socle, le restaurant peut commander à son fournisseur parce qu'un lien le déclare et que la gouvernance l'autorise, et une action que personne n'a déclarée est refusée avec sa raison.

platforms.code:
# a platform of platforms: the group itself becomes one world of a holding
oHolding = new stzSuperApp("holding")
oHolding.AddConstellation("acme", oCon)
? oHolding.NumberOfWorlds()
? oHolding.KindOf("acme")
? oHolding.WorldQ("acme").NumberOfWorlds()
platforms.what_en: The whole platform then becomes one world of a larger one: the holding holds one world, that world is itself a constellation, and its two worlds are still inside.
platforms.what_fr: La plateforme entière devient ensuite un monde d'une plateforme plus grande : la holding contient un monde, ce monde est lui-même une constellation, et ses deux mondes sont toujours dedans.
